thread.back.description: The button at the top of a post's screen that goes back to where the reader came from.

thread.label.description: The name of the feed of a post with what it replies to and its replies, for assistive technology.

thread.earlier.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {前の投稿を#件表示}}
thread.earlier.description: The fold, in a thread, of the posts between its first post and the two the focused post replies to closest; pressing it shows them. count is how many.

thread.replies.description: The heading of the replies under the focused post of a thread.

thread.more_replies.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {さらに#件の返信を表示}}
thread.more_replies.description: The fold at the end of a thread's replies; pressing it shows more of them. count is how many.

thread.no_replies.defaultMessage: まだ返信はありません。
thread.no_replies.description: What a post's screen says under a post that has no replies.

thread.loading.defaultMessage: 投稿を読み込んでいます…
thread.loading.description: What a post's screen says while the post and its thread load.

thread.failed.defaultMessage: 投稿を読み込めませんでした。
thread.failed.description: What a post's screen says when the post could not be loaded (it was deleted, or the reader may not see it, or the server did not answer), beside a button to try again.

thread.retry.description: The button that loads the post again after it failed.
